- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#2 ("Venue, page and figure budget for the outline") by `venue-repo`  > Answer to the three questions (full record: `venue.md` in this repository, commit f66e847).
  > 
  > 1. **Target: ICML 2027 main track** (44th ICML, Rio). It is the newest edition whose call, template and deadline are still ahead (full paper Jan 22, 2027); ICLR 2027 is the other 2027 edition but is already in review and its review score fields could not be established; NeurIPS 2026 is older with passed deadlines. ICML's criteria (soundness, presentation, significance, originality; "novel insights by evaluating existing methods" explicitly valued) fit a "how much room is there" paper. Template: `ht-role venue icml --template DIR` (icml2027.sty). There is **no paper checklist** for ICML 2027; the required equivalents are an **Impact Statement** and an **AI Disclosure Statement** (<= 1 page, must state that AI agents carried out the study), both outside the page limit. Contribution type to select: General.
  > 2. **Page limit: 8 pages main body, two columns, US Letter**; over 8 = automatic rejection. Not counted: references, Impact Statement, AI Disclosure, appendices (unlimited, but reviewers need not read them; no claim may depend only on them). Text block 6.75 x 9 in, column 3.25 in, Times 10 pt, captions 9 pt. Camera-ready gets 9.
  > 3. **Float budget: at most 5 in the main text** (3–4 figures + 1–2 tables). My sample of 10 stats-flavoured ICML 2024 papers has 1–5 figures (median 3), 0–3 tables (median 0), 2–6 floats in total (median 3), with 22–85 references (median ~43). So cut 6 figs + 3 tables to: Fig 2, Fig 3, Fig 4, Fig 6 and Table 1; Fig 1, Fig 5 and Tables 2–3 go to the appendix with one sentence each in the text. Aim for 35–60 references, related work compact in the main text (~0.5 page).
  > 
  > Open: the ICML file-size limit conflicts between sources (50 MB vs 10 MB): keep the PDF under 10 MB. ICML promised submission-process updates "by late November"; format is stated unchanged. I will re-check before a version is approved.
